messages:
Jordan: scheduling Nightingale private/VPC cutover for customer nightingale-co next Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC. can folks confirm quiet window and who will own rollback?
Riley: I can take primary on the cutover. planning to be online 01:30-03:30 UTC for prechecks + smoke.
Sam: i'll own smoke tests and metrics checks. can you drop the smoke checklist here?
Jordan: copied checklist below — short smoke only: 1) endpoint respond <200ms for 5 requests 2) traceback-free logs for 5 sample prompts 3) KV cache warmup check.
Meera: pinging infra for reserved hosts. @DeployBot did the vpc reservation go through?
DeployBot: Reservation created: nightingale-co / vpc-rlz-07, slot 2024-03-06T02:00:00Z-03:00:00Z, reserved by jordan. Run `rb status vpc-rlz-07` to view.
Riley: thanks. is there a canary plan? thinking 10% traffic to new nodes for 10m then ramp.
Jordan: yes — canary -> 10m -> 50% -> full in 30m total. rollback cut at any failure during canary or at smoke fail.
Sam: smoke commands i'll run: ```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://private.example/api/v1/generate | jq '.latency,.error'
kubectl logs -n nightingale --tail=200 | grep -i error
```
Meera: infra checklist: snapshots of config pushed, node images verified, SSM access for on-call. i'll attach AMI IDs in confluence after lunch.
OpsOnCall: i'm on shift that window, will be reachable via pager. if rollback needed i can trigger the autoswitch to previous ASG.
Riley: code-review note — pushing final config PR now (https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/543). @Sam @Meera please LGTM when you can.
Sam: reviewing now, small nit on env var naming. will approve in 20m.
Meera: LGTM, added terraform change to pin security group.
Jordan: thanks — final timeline: 01:30 staging prechecks, 02:00 start cutover, 02:10 canary, 02:20 ramp, 02:45 full. rollback window until 03:00 then monitoring until 03:30.
Riley: i'll post progress updates in this thread during the window. :thumbsup:
Sam: i'll run the smoke script after canary and report metrics (p50/p95).
DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: nightingale-co cutover in 24 hours.
Jordan: all set. if anything changes ping here and @OpsOnCall. good luck team. :rocket:
